The two index tables (OFLT 0..19, SENS 0..26) are the only sourced write bounds. The fake's start values are placeholders, not facts. Safety: the e-stop writes SLVL 0 and the safe state is the sine output amplitude at 0 V; no hardware e-stop is needed at R1.
